Before the epoch the farm wires 60166 POA and sets aside 31430 minutes of labour, all sunk before any prize is counted. The echo opens the gate, the tide pays the toll, the ember proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer will pay. Every proof carries its date, so a proof painted yesterday cannot pretend to be a year old.
